items.title: Three Iran-backed suspects plotted attacks including RAF Fairford incident, US says
items.description: The US Department of Justice says the men were involved in a string of plots, including a major incident near the UK airbase that is used by US armed forces.

items.title: Spain sees widespread disruption in first general strike for 14 years
items.description: Protests are also expected in the biggest cities less than three weeks before Spaniards vote in parliamentary elections.

items.title: US House blocks bid to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth
items.description: Trump welcomes the outcome, praising Hegseth as a "Great American Patriot", but Democrats can try again next year.

items.title: Hundreds of Italian schools hit by threats in suspected bomb hoax
items.description: Emails containing the false warnings were sent to schools in Rome, Naples, Vicenza, Florence, Pisa, Trieste and other Italian cities, officials say.

items.title: Four grizzly bears killed in Canada after fatal attack on mother and daughter
items.description: The sow and her three cubs were responsible for killing Jennifer Balcarras, 48, and her daughter Selah Reed, 20, earlier this month.

items.title: Meghan's father Thomas Markle back in federal custody after allegedly removing ankle monitor
items.description: The 82-year-old was placed under house detention in Florida last week after being charged over possession of child sex abuse material.

items.title: Vinícius Jr sends message to Sudan boy who received prosthetic legs after BBC report sparks appeal
items.description: Double amputee Zaher told the BBC last year about his favourite footballer and a dream of being able to walk again.

items.title: Haitian PM praises El Salvador after joint strike on alleged home of gang leader
items.description: The 400 Mawozo gang was targeted by El Salvador's military, which has deployed thousands of troops to combat Haiti's gang violence crisis.

items.title: Kenya discharges last Ebola patient in major milestone towards virus-free status
items.description: The country begins a 42-day countdown to being declared Ebola-free, provided no new cases are recorded.

items.title: Kennedys sue to block Trump's arch, arguing it would cast shadow on JFK's grave
items.description: Nine members of the political dynasty say the 250ft structure would cast a shadow on gravesites.

items.title: Transport workers in Chile block highways in protest over surging fuel prices
items.description: Hundreds of bus and lorry drivers are blocking traffic along major highway routes across the country.

items.title: Judge allows Trump's $10bn defamation case against BBC to proceed
items.description: But the court dismisses the other part of Trump's lawsuit that alleged the BBC had violated a Florida law.

claude-code.name: minicode
claude-code.description: A light native macOS editor for working alongside Claude Code: language servers, a terminal, a browser pane, Markdown and LaTeX previews, and views of what agents did and left running. Written in C++ with no Electron; GTK4 and Android ports share its core.

claude-code.name: ecc-workflow
claude-code.description: A gated, stack-agnostic Claude Code skill that takes a project from an empty folder to a shipped product: PRD, approved HTML preview, architecture, test-first slices, review, and release — with no application code before the preview and plan are approved.

claude-code.name: rspec
claude-code.description: Claude Code plugin: reverse-spec an existing product into features, user stories and technical specs, ready to rebuild it for learning or personal use.

claude-code.name: memory-lean
claude-code.description: A token-lean MCP memory server for AI coding agents: a knowledge graph your agent can search without reading the whole thing. Drop-in replacement for the reference memory server.

claude-code.name: trailmark
claude-code.description: A per-project memory for Claude Code and Codex: every new session picks up where the last one stopped.
